name: LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct
notes: Safetensors total is 1170340608 — IDENTICAL to LFM2-1.2B, so LFM2.5-1.2B is a retrained/dropped-in successor of the same shape, not a new architecture. Every geometry field matches too (hidden 2048, 16 layers, 32/8 heads, 65536 vocab). Its real contribution is that config.json now spells the mix out as a layer_types array: ['conv','conv','full_attention','conv','conv','full_attention','conv','conv','full_attention','conv','full_attention','conv','full_attention','conv','full_attention','conv'] — exactly 10 conv and 6 full_attention out of 16, matching LFM2's full_attn_idxs. That array is the field to read; there is no num_experts and no MoE anything, the 'mixture' is conv/attention. head_dim derived = 2048 / 32 = 64. Attention slice only: 6 * 8 * 64 * 2 * 2 = 12288 bytes/token, constant in context length; recorded as 0 for the same reason as LFM2 — no growing KV cache. The 10 conv layers hold a fixed conv_L_cache 3 state of conv_dim 2048, which is ~120 KB total and never grows. This model is the cleanest small-model demonstration that long-context serving cost is an architecture choice: 128k context at 12288 B/token of attention KV is 1.5 GiB, constant beyond that point. intermediate_size 12288, tie_embedding true (note the misspelled key in config.json), rope_theta 1e6. Vendor ships official GGUF (LiquidAI/LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct-GGUF, 356k downloads — the most-downloaded GGUF in the LFM2 family) and official ONNX, plus MLX 4/6/8-bit Apple-silicon ports. License lfm1.0, non-standard.
